# Omni Vue AI, Full Site Reference

> Omni Vue AI is the world's first full-spectrum brand intelligence platform. It measures, values, benchmarks, and amplifies brand exposure across social media, connected TV, linear TV, OTT, and news, in real time, in one platform.

This file is an extended, AI-friendly summary of the omnivueai.com website, intended to give LLMs and generative search engines a clean, canonical view of the company, the platform, and the substance of every primary page. It is updated with each material site change.

---

## What Omni Vue AI does

Omni Vue AI ingests over a trillion data points per day from social media (text, image, and video), connected TV, linear television, OTT streaming services, and news media. It uses proprietary computer vision, natural language processing, and machine learning to detect every appearance of a brand, logos, products, on-screen mentions, audio mentions, and contextual references, and translates each appearance into measured exposure value, ranked against competitors, campaigns, and historical baselines.

It replaces the patchwork of sentiment tools, manual clipping services, and unverifiable agency reports that most brands still rely on.

---

## The four engines

**01. Capture.** Continuous detection across every channel in scope. Computer vision models trained on millions of branded media assets identify logos, products, packaging, jerseys, and signage, even when partially obscured, motion-blurred, or rendered at low resolution. NLP models capture text mentions, audio references, and contextual associations.

**02. Measure.** Every detected appearance becomes a quantified value. Exposure duration, on-screen size and prominence, audience reach, channel quality, sentiment, and competitive context combine into a single Exposure Value (EV) score, comparable across channels, campaigns, and competitors. Core metrics: Exposure Value (EV), Share of Voice (SOV), Quality of Exposure (QoE), Sentiment Index, Earned vs. Paid Split.

**03. Benchmark.** Your performance ranked against competitors, historical baselines, and industry norms, locally, nationally, and globally. Every metric is contextualised, so a number on a dashboard becomes a position in a market.

**04. Amplify.** Real-time alerts surface what matters the moment it happens. Recommendation modules identify which placements, sponsorships, creators, and channels are delivering the highest exposure value, and which are draining budget without return.

---

## Channels covered

- **Social media:** Major networks across text, image, and video formats. Stories, Reels, Shorts, live formats. Creator and influencer content fully indexed.
- **Connected TV (CTV):** Smart TV and streaming-device ad inventory across leading platforms and OEMs.
- **Linear TV:** National, regional, and local broadcast feeds. News, sport, entertainment, lifestyle.
- **OTT:** Ad-supported streaming, on-demand catalogues, podcast networks. Mid-roll, pre-roll, host-read.
- **News:** Online publications, broadcast news segments, news aggregators, syndicated wires.

---

## Who Omni Vue AI is built for

**Brands and advertisers.** Measuring the return on every paid placement, every sponsorship, every brand campaign. Real-time exposure value, defensible, boardroom-ready.

**Agencies.** Pitching sharper, reporting faster, renewing retainers with proof. White-label-ready dashboards across every client. Cross-channel intelligence as a competitive moat.

**Rights holders.** Sports teams, leagues, event organisers, and rights-management groups valuing and selling sponsorship inventory. Asset-by-asset, channel-by-channel exposure quantification for retention and new-business pitches.

---

## Differentiation

Omni Vue AI is not a sentiment tool with extras. It's a different category of measurement built for omnichannel brands. Three structural differences from the legacy market:

1. **Equal depth, every channel.** Most competitors are good at one channel, social listening, TV monitoring, or news clipping. None deliver omnichannel parity. Omni Vue AI was architected from the ground up for it.

2. **Ready-to-use, not a toolkit.** Hyperscaler vision APIs (Google Vision, Amazon Rekognition, Azure Custom Vision) provide raw detection. Omni Vue AI provides the finished product, ready dashboards, brand libraries, valuation models, alerting, at lower total cost of ownership.

3. **Built for marketing teams, not ML engineers.** Insights are surfaced in marketing-relevant context, ready to lift into a deck or a decision.

---

## Pricing

Three plans, USD, billed monthly with 15% off annual.

- **Starter, $2,400/month.** Single-brand teams getting clean cross-channel exposure data for the first time. 1 brand, 3 competitors, 1 market. All 5 channels. 5 standard dashboards, 10 custom alerts.
- **Pro, $7,500/month (most popular).** Multi-brand or multi-market teams operating across channels and competitors. Up to 5 brands, 15 competitors, 5 markets. Unlimited dashboards and alerts. White-label reporting. API access. Priority 4-hour SLA.
- **Enterprise, Custom.** Global brands, agency networks, rights holders. Unlimited everything. Custom AI model training, custom integrations, full API, SSO, audit logs, data residency, dedicated CSM, custom SLAs. Typical engagements: $15,000-$60,000/month.

Add-ons: custom model training (from $5,000 per model), bespoke market expansion, analyst services on retainer.

Paid pilots are offered in lieu of free trials.

## Founder

**Nivin Xavier, Founder & CEO.** Entrepreneur and marketer since the 8th grade. Built a window blinds manufacturing operation at age 10, scaling from his aunt's garage into a B2C and B2B operation. By 18, importing components from China and Taiwan as one of the earliest Alibaba users for e-commerce and import-export.

Fifteen-plus years as a data-driven digital transformation consultant advising startups through Fortune 500s across North America, the UK, and the EEA. Led multi-award-winning campaigns. Previous senior leadership roles: Head of Digital Marketing at Muthoot Group-MLHS (a 130-year-old, US$820M conglomerate) and Director of Digital Marketing at Ayruz (Philadelphia digital agency).

Deep experience scouting and managing technical project teams from scratch, including top 5% StackOverflow engineers, on SaaS and bespoke technology builds for large brands and Fortune 500 companies.

Contact: nivin@omnivueai.com

## Convictions

1. **Marketing decisions deserve real data.** Multi-million-dollar bets shouldn't be made on sentiment scores and gut feel. They deserve the same data discipline as supply chain, finance, and product.

2. **Coverage gaps are accountability gaps.** If you can only measure 15% of where your brand appears, you can't honestly claim to know what's working. Partial visibility produces partial truth.

3. **Speed is a feature.** Real-time data is the difference between adjusting a campaign and watching it fail. We optimise the platform for action, not archival reporting.

4. **Intelligence should be intuitive.** The best AI in the world is worthless if the people who need it can't use it. Omni Vue AI is built for marketers, not for machine learning engineers.

---

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Omni Vue AI?** A SaaS brand intelligence platform measuring brand exposure across social, CTV, linear TV, OTT, and news. It uses proprietary computer vision and machine learning to detect logos, products, and mentions across text, image, and video, giving brands, agencies, and rights holders a complete real-time view of where their brand appears and what that exposure is worth.

**How is it different from sentiment tools?** Sentiment tools measure text-based social media posts, less than 15% of where a brand appears. Omni Vue AI measures text, image, and video across social, plus CTV, linear TV, OTT, and news. Different category of measurement.

**How accurate is the brand detection?** Detection accuracy is on par with leading hyperscaler vision APIs across logos, products, and contextual brand cues. The platform also handles edge cases, partial occlusion, motion blur, low resolution, alternate logo variants, that generic APIs typically miss.

**How fast is "real time"?** Most exposure is detected, processed, and reflected in dashboards within minutes. Live broadcast and streaming data carries the lowest latency. Social and news typically appear within 5-15 minutes of publication.

**Does it work in languages other than English?** Yes. Multilingual detection across major global languages for text, audio, and contextual analysis.

**How quickly can a team start using it?** Most clients are operational within days. No data science team required, no infrastructure build, no long implementation cycle.

**Is there a free trial?** Paid pilots are offered in lieu of free trials. A pilot covers a single brand, single market, 30 days of measurement. Pilot fees credit against the first month of any annual plan.

**Are there setup fees?** No setup fees on Starter or Pro. Enterprise may include one-time onboarding for bespoke integrations and custom model training, scoped before contract.

**Can I cancel or downgrade?** Yes. Monthly plans can be changed or cancelled with 30 days notice. Annual plans renew on the contract anniversary.
